services.name: Comedy Classes
services.desc: The Laughing Skull Lounge Stand Up comedy class is a six week comedy course that ends with a graduation show! We apply lessons from the best comedians in the country and help you create a solid 5-8 minute set to use as you wish. We sell out almost every class, so if you are interested, we suggest you sign up now! Classes are on Saturdays from 10:00 am to 1:00 pm at the world famous Laughing Skull Lounge. Nestled inside the iconic Vortex Bar & Grill on Peachtree Street in Midtown, it offers audiences a full night out in one of Atlanta’s liveliest neighborhoods. The club blends showcase-style lineups with special headliner performances, highlighting both rising stars and established names. With a strong focus on developing talent, it regularly features the funniest nationally touring and local comedians, performing their best 10 minute sets every night.
